My previous COP buys were predicated on Argus Research's $153 PT and strong fundamentals, which remain, but the near-term catalyst (geopolitical tension supporting oil) is reversing. Trimming to ~8% reduces risk while keeping meaningful upside if oil stabilizes. The +4.24% unrealized gain cushions the trim.
